speaker: NARRATOR
en:
Stellar Calendar 24th.
In the deep space.
The "Life" base.
zh:
星海历24年。
宇宙深处。
"生命"基地。
name: ch1/nar_01.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
Martha aces her final test.
She's now a member of "Huntress".
zh:
玛莎以全优成绩通过最终考核。
她正式成为"Huntress"中队的一员。
name: ch1/nar_02.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
When she is just off the plane.
Heading for the rest area.
Announcement sounds.
zh:
她刚走下飞机。
正走向休息区。
警报骤然响起。
name: ch1/nar_03.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
Tower: "Hostile objects approaching!
All fighters scramble!"
zh:
塔台:"检测到大量不明飞行物!
所有战机紧急升空!"
name: ch1/nar_04.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: "Repeat: Scramble! Scramble!"
zh: "重复:紧急升空!紧急升空!"
name: ch1/nar_05.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
At the same moment,
a series of massive explosions behind her.
She turns --
zh:
与此同时,
身后传来一连串巨大的爆炸。
她猛地回头——
name: ch1/nar_06.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: All fighters become wreckage...
zh: 所有战机,皆成残骸……
name: ch1/nar_07.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
Martha runs back to the hangar.
Only one old trainer left.
zh:
玛莎冲回机库。
只剩一架老旧的教练机。
name: ch1/nar_08.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
Into the cockpit. Engines up.
She reports:
"I'm taking off. Flight code:21395"
zh:
她登上座舱,引擎启动。
她向塔台汇报:
"我准备起飞。飞行代码21395"
name: ch1/nar_09.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
No response from the tower.
Only a sharp, harsh noise.
zh:
塔台没有回应。
只有一阵刺耳的噪声。
name: ch1/nar_10.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
Martha heads into space.
Again and alone.
zh:
玛莎飞向太空。
再一次,孤身一人。
name: ch1/nar_11.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
A hard-won victory. But the cost is plain.
The "Life" base lies scarred and broken.
Repairs will take weeks.
zh:
一场艰难的胜利。代价却清晰可见。
"生命"基地满目疮痍。
修复工作将持续数周。
name: ch2/nar_01.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
The shockwave defense system,
pushed far beyond its limits,
needs a full overhaul
before it can fire again.
zh:
冲击波防御系统,
被推至极限之外,
需要彻底的检修
才能再次开火。
name: ch2/nar_02.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
The base's long-range comms array
is destroyed.
Martha must fly to the
"Moonwell" R&D center,
with Bryssa in her backseat,
to bring home new equipment.
zh:
基地的大功率通讯设备
已被摧毁。
玛莎必须飞往
"月井"研发中心,
后座载着Bryssa,
运回新的设备。
name: ch2/nar_03.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
Ally enters its standby mode.
Bryssa, exhausted, drifts off.
The old trainer's engine hums
a tired, weary vibration.
zh:
Ally进入待机状态。
精疲力竭的Bryssa沉沉睡去。
老旧教练机的引擎
发出疲惫的震动。
name: ch2/nar_04.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: Space is terribly quiet...
zh: 宇宙安静得可怕……
name: ch2/nar_05.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
After an eternity in the void,
the R&D center finally
drifts into Martha's comms range.
zh:
在虚空中度过漫长的时光后,
研发中心终于
进入了玛莎的通讯范围。
name: ch2/nar_08.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
Martha opens the channel.
"Moonwell, Moonwell, this is Martha
from 'Life' base. Flight code 21395."
zh:
玛莎尝试建立通讯。
"月井,月井,这里是'生命'基地的玛莎。
飞行代码21395。"
name: ch2/nar_09.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: Silence.
zh: 没有回应。
name: ch2/nar_11.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
"Moonwell, Moonwell, 21395.
Requesting landing clearance."
zh:
"月井,月井,这里是21395。
申请飞机停泊。"
name: ch2/nar_12.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: Nothing but still silence.
zh: 依旧毫无回应。
name: ch2/nar_13.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
Martha has already flown to the center's gate.
A massive vacuum door blocks her way.
zh:
玛莎已经飞到了研究中心的门前。
巨大的真空门将她挡在外面。
name: ch2/nar_14.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: CH.3  ENEMY FORTRESS
zh: 第三章  敌人要塞
name: ch3/nar_01.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: We have located the enemy stronghold.
zh: 我们已定位敌人的据点。
name: ch3/nar_02.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: Break through their defense line!
zh: 突破他们的防线!
name: ch3/nar_03.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: CH.4  ASTEROID BELT
zh: 第四章  小行星带
name: ch4/nar_01.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: Danger lurks among the asteroids.
zh: 危险潜伏在小行星之间。
name: ch4/nar_02.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: Fly carefully and stay alert.
zh: 小心飞行,保持警惕。
name: ch4/nar_03.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: CH.5  FINAL ASSAULT
zh: 第五章  最终突击
name: ch5/nar_01.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: This is the final battle.
zh: 这是最后的战役。
name: ch5/nar_02.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: Give it everything you've got!
zh: 倾尽全力!
name: ch5/nar_03.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
The Warden falls.
The lab falls silent.
zh:
守护者倒下了。
实验室归于寂静。
name: ch2/nar_15.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
The long-range comms unit is found intact.
Bryssa loads it into the trainer's hold.
zh:
大功率通讯设备完好无损。
Bryssa将它装入教练机的货舱。
name: ch2/nar_16.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en:
Martha takes one last look at Moonwell.
The engines roar to life.
zh:
玛莎最后看了一眼月井。
引擎轰鸣着苏醒。
name: ch2/nar_17.wav

speaker: NARRATOR
en: Home. The "Life" base is waiting.
zh:
回家。
"生命"基地正在等待。
name: ch2/nar_18.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Martha, you're the only one in the air.
zh: 玛莎,现在只有你起飞了。
name: ch1/dlg_ally_01.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Hold on as long as you can. The base shockwave cannon is charging.
zh: 你尽可能撑住,基地的冲击波防御炮正在准备。
name: ch1/dlg_ally_02.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: These enemies are made of energy.
zh: 这些敌人都是能量体构成的。
name: ch1/dlg_ally_03.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Destroy them. We can collect the energy.
zh: 击碎他们,我们可以得到能量。
name: ch1/dlg_ally_04.wav

en: Tower communication restored.
zh: 塔台恢复通讯。
name: ch1/dlg_system_01.wav

speaker: Tower (ai)
en: Shockwave cannon ready.
zh: 防御炮已经准备好了。
name: ch1/dlg_tower_01.wav

speaker: Bryssa from Tower
en: A little more energy!
zh: 还需要一点点能量!
name: ch1/dlg_bryssa_01.wav

speaker: Tower (ai)
en: Defense system charged.
zh: 防御体系充能成功。
name: ch1/dlg_tower_02.wav

speaker: Tower (ai)
en: More enemies incoming. Keep gathering energy.
zh: 敌人越来越多,请继续积攒能量。
name: ch1/dlg_tower_03.wav

speaker: Bryssa from Tower
en: The trainer shares energy with the base.
zh: 训练机和基地共享能量系统。
name: ch1/dlg_bryssa_02.wav

speaker: Bryssa from Tower
en: You and the base will upgrade together.
zh: 你会和基地同步升级!
name: ch1/dlg_bryssa_03.wav

speaker: Tower (ai)
en: Keep gathering energy.
zh: 请继续积攒能量。
name: ch1/dlg_tower_04.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: System checking.
zh: 系统自检。
name: ch1/dlg_ally_05.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Done.
zh: 自检完成。
name: ch1/dlg_ally_06.wav

speaker: Tower (ai)
en: Base upgraded again.
zh: 基地已再次获得升级。
name: ch1/dlg_tower_05.wav

speaker: Bryssa from Tower
en: Radar shows even more enemies! Watch out!
zh: 雷达上显示的敌人越来越多了,小心!
name: ch1/dlg_bryssa_04.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: System checking result:
zh: 系统自检结果:
name: ch1/dlg_ally_07.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Aim assist system on this plane.
zh: 本机搭载了瞄准辅助系统。
name: ch1/dlg_ally_08.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: You shall find it somewhere.
zh: 你应该能在某处找到它。
name: ch1/dlg_ally_09.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: I've lost contact with the tower!
zh: 我和塔台失去通讯了!
name: ch1/dlg_ally_10.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: But you and the base can upgrade again soon.
zh: 不过你和基地很快又可以进行一次升级。
name: ch1/dlg_ally_11.wav

speaker: Tower (ai)
en: Massive energy signature detected.
zh: 检测到巨大能量信号。
name: ch1/dlg_tower_06.wav

speaker: Tower (ai)
en: Analyzing source...
zh: 正在分析来源……
name: ch1/dlg_tower_07.wav

speaker: Bryssa from Tower
en: It's a capital ship.
zh: 是一艘主力舰。
name: ch1/dlg_bryssa_05.wav

speaker: Bryssa from Tower
en: Telamondo-class. Martha, this is what the defense system was built for.
zh: Telamondo级。玛莎,这就是防御体系存在的意义。
name: ch1/dlg_bryssa_06.wav

speaker: Tower (ai)
en: Enemy capital ship approaching.
zh: 敌方主力舰正在逼近。
name: ch1/dlg_tower_08.wav

speaker: Tower (ai)
en: Entering weapons range in 40 seconds.
zh: 预计40秒后进入射程。
name: ch1/dlg_tower_09.wav

speaker: Bryssa from Tower
en: Shockwave Defense System is fully charged
zh: 冲击波防御系统已完全充能。
name: ch1/dlg_bryssa_07.wav

speaker: Bryssa from Tower
en: Martha, just keep them off us!
zh: 玛莎,守住防线!
name: ch1/dlg_bryssa_08.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Here it comes...!
zh: 它来了……!
name: ch1/dlg_ally_12.wav

speaker: Bryssa from Tower
en: Base defense systems are strengthening.
zh: 基地防御体系正在加强。
name: ch1/dlg_bryssa_09.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Firepower systems being enhanced.
zh: 正在加强火力体系。
name: ch1/dlg_ally_13.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Telamondo can absorb energy!
zh: Telamondo能够吸收能量!
name: ch1/dlg_ally_14.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Our firepower can match it!
zh: 我们的火力足够应对!
name: ch1/dlg_ally_15.wav

speaker: Bryssa
en: Are we there? ... Why did we stop?
zh: 到了?……怎么停了?
name: ch2/dlg_bryssa_01.wav

speaker: Martha
en: 'Moonwell' ... no response at all.
zh: "月井"……完全没有反应。
name: ch2/dlg_martha_01.wav

speaker: Bryssa
en: So we can't get in?
zh: 那我们进不去了?
name: ch2/dlg_bryssa_02.wav

speaker: Martha
en: Hold on. I'll have Ally try to link into their system.
zh: 别急,我让Ally试试能不能接入研究中心的系统。
name: ch2/dlg_martha_02.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Accessing Moonwell system.
zh: 接入研究中心中。
name: ch2/dlg_ally_02.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Connecting. Please wait.
zh: 接入中,请稍等。
name: ch2/dlg_ally_03.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: All their devices are offline. But the facility still has power.
zh: 他们的设备都是关机状态。但是建筑内依旧有电力。
name: ch2/dlg_ally_04.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: ... Preparing to emit a strong pulse signal. Forcefully waking up nearby hardware.
zh: ……准备发射强力脉冲信号,强行启动周围硬件设备。
name: ch2/dlg_ally_05.wav

speaker: Moonwell (ai)
en: Scanning code. Verifying ID.
zh: 正在扫描代码。验证身份。
name: ch2/dlg_moonwell_01.wav

speaker: Moonwell (ai)
en: Flight code verified, 21395. Cargo confirmed. No obvious threats. You may proceed.
zh: 飞行代码已验证,21395。内容物确认,无明显威胁。请通行。
name: ch2/dlg_moonwell_02.wav

speaker: Moonwell (ai)
en: Welcome, Martha. Ally.
zh: 欢迎,玛莎。Ally。
name: ch2/dlg_moonwell_03.wav

speaker: Martha
en: We're in. The whole facility is silent.
zh: 我们进来了。整座设施寂静无声。
name: ch2/dlg_martha_03.wav

speaker: Bryssa
en: It feels like no one has been here for years.
zh: 感觉这里已经好几年没人来过了。
name: ch2/dlg_bryssa_03.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Main power is online. No life signs detected.
zh: 主电源在线。未检测到生命信号。
name: ch2/dlg_ally_06.wav

speaker: Martha
en: Stay sharp. We came here for the comms equipment.
zh: 保持警惕。我们来这里是为了通讯设备。
name: ch2/dlg_martha_04.wav

speaker: Bryssa
en: Martha... what is THAT?
zh: 玛莎……那是什么?
name: ch2/dlg_bryssa_04.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Massive object ahead! Slowing down!
zh: 前方发现巨大物体!正在减速!
name: ch2/dlg_ally_07.wav

speaker: Martha
en: Brace yourselves.
zh: 大家做好心理准备。
name: ch2/dlg_martha_05.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Its surface is shifting. Blue to orange!
zh: 它的表面在变化。蓝色变成橙色了!
name: ch2/dlg_ally_08.wav

speaker: Martha
en: Orange means vulnerable. Open fire!
zh: 橙色代表可以攻击。开火!
name: ch2/dlg_martha_06.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Energy constructs! We'll have to fight through!
zh: 这些是能量构造体!我们只能一路打过去了!
name: ch2/dlg_ally_09.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: That one dropped something! Break the shell, grab the core!
zh: 那个家伙掉了东西!打碎外壳,抓住核心!
name: ch2/dlg_ally_10.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Pulse skill online! Full bar + SHIFT to release.
zh: 脉冲技能上线!能量满时按Shift释放。
name: ch2/dlg_ally_11.wav

speaker: Bryssa
en: Look! The center of the lab...
zh: 快看!实验室中央……
name: ch2/dlg_bryssa_05.wav

speaker: Martha
en: A fighter. A real one.
zh: 一架战斗机。一架真正的战斗机。
name: ch2/dlg_martha_07.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Prototype identified: NightElf. Touch it to transfer control.
zh: 原型机确认:暗夜精灵号。触碰以接管控制权。
name: ch2/dlg_ally_12.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: NightElf online. Welcome aboard, Martha.
zh: 暗夜精灵号上线。欢迎登机,玛莎。
name: ch2/dlg_ally_13.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Chain hits to charge white energy. Full bar = triple fire!
zh: 连续命中积攒白色能量。满格即可三炮齐发!
name: ch2/dlg_ally_14.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: Massive energy signature! It's blocking the exit!
zh: 巨大能量信号!它挡住了出口!
name: ch2/dlg_ally_15.wav

speaker: Martha
en: Then we go through it.
zh: 那就从它身上碾过去。
name: ch2/dlg_martha_08.wav

speaker: Ally (ai copilot)
en: It's enraged! Watch the patterns!
zh: 它狂暴了!小心弹幕!
name: ch2/dlg_ally_16.wav
